categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Changes core PSBT data structure handling in src/psbt.cpp; behavior exposed via joinpsbts belongs to PSBT/wallet logic rather than RPC machinery.
categories.rationale: The PR modifies PSBT data handling rather than RPC framework or interface code, and the RPC category excludes behavior an RPC merely exposes.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: PSBT area label and changes to PSBT input handling in src/psbt.cpp that directly affect wallet signing workflows (walletprocesspsbt).
categories.rationale: Fixes an issue where joined PSBTs containing signed Taproot inputs retain invalid signatures and cannot be signed or finalized with walletprocesspsbt. While legacy and SegWit v0 signatures were already cleared in PartiallySignedTransaction::AddInput, Taproot signatures were not, leading to walletprocesspsbt returning complete: false.
